predecessors.en: Territory of Papua and New Guinea

summary.ru: Папуа — Новая Гвинея — государство в Океании, расположенное в юго-западной части Тихого океана и занимающее восточную часть острова Новая Гвинея, архипелаг Бисмарка, северную часть Соломоновых островов, о-ва Д’Антркасто и др.
summary.en: Papua New Guinea, officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, is an island nation in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia. It has a land border with Indonesia to the west and maritime borders with Australia to the south and the Solomon Islands to the east. Its capital is Port Moresby. The country's 462,840 km2 (178,700 mi2) includes a large mainland and hundreds of islands.
